builds.name: Five-champion Moonfall ceiling
builds.summary: Seek the highest damage from Five-champion Moonfall within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.goal: Seek the highest damage from Five-champion Moonfall within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.hypothesis: R3 is400+0.6AP plus85+0.15AP per extra champion. Five legal enemies mean four extras:740+1.2AP per victim. AP and MR modifiers strengthen explosion. Deathcap multiplies AP; Zhonya adds105AP; Riftmaker adds bonusHP-to-AP and8% full-ramp damage. Void/Shadowflame penetrate MR and amplify eligible low-health hits. Nearby Abyssal makes target take12% more magic damage. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

ceiling.finiteState: Benchmark game30min,level18,max target rank,no elixirs/dragons/unlisted allied buffs. Enemy3000maxHP,900currentHP,100armor,50MR,1500bonusHP before legal debuffs; record raw overkill separately. All five enemy champions pulled. Riftmaker fully ramped before measured packet.

Enemy3000maxHP,900currentHP,100armor,50MR,1500bonusHP before legal debuffs; record raw overkill separately. All five enemy champions pulled. Riftmaker fully ramped before measured packet.

Same-patch practice/custom test with exact state: record Five-champion Moonfall tooltip, observed AP/AD/HP/mana/resists, per-packet damage/protection and final targetHP. Compare one legal item swap at a time, separating setup damage, rune/item procs and ordinary attack. Verify raw helper/statFormula mappings and conditional multipliers before treating result as established.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The initial form fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR); adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

Confidence: plausible. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.

kitEvidence.formula:
Diana Pulls In, Slows by [40 / 50 / 60]%, and reveals nearby enemies for [2] seconds.

If Diana hits at least one enemy champion, she calls to the moon, dealing [200 / 300 / 400 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage plus [35 / 60 / 85 + (0.15) × AP] for each champion pulled beyond the first, up to a max of an additional [(35 / 60 / 85 + (0.15) × AP) × (5)] damage.
